Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup: Sept. 22

AI thermal modeling for 2.5D/3D ICs; chiplet and AI accelerator co-design; BEOL thermal conductivity; agentic DRC repair; RL for dense-layout routing; LLM orchestration for digital EDA; chiplet interconnects for neuromorphic computing.

September 22nd, 2026 -

By: Linda Christensen

New technical papers recently added to Semiconductor Engineering’s library:
